entities.summary: John Kevin Delaney is an American businessman, politician, and former attorney who was the United States representative for Maryland's 6th congressional district from 2013 to 2019. He is the Founder and Chairman of Forbright Bank and was a candidate in the 2020 Democratic presidential primaries.
